The photo shows a single slice of sourdough-style bread on a square plate.

**Scale:** The plate spans about 440 px, and I'm assuming it is roughly 24 cm wide, so about 18 px per cm. The slice is about 230 px wide and 250 px tall, which is roughly 12-13 cm by 13 cm. That is a fairly large slice, probably cut from a round loaf.

**Weight:** Slice thickness is probably about 1.5-2 cm. The area is about 140 cm², and an open-crumb sourdough has a density of about 0.25 g/cm³. That gives roughly 140 × 1.7 × 0.25 ≈ 60 g, so I'll say 60 g.

**Energy:** Sourdough has about 270 kcal per 100 g, so 60 g is about 160 kcal. The slice looks lightly toasted and has no visible butter.
